title: Constructive Graph State-Sum, Isoperimetric, and Dyadic-Placement Certificates for Separating Valiant's Algebraic Hierarchy
abstract: We present VALIANT-HIER-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point verification framework and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel auditing the core finite-dimensional algebraic, isoperimetric, tensor-rank, dyadic-placement, determinant-cofactor, and graph-minor mechanisms underlying OpenAI's November 24, 2026 unrefereed preprint 'Paths, trees and grids separate Valiant's hierarchy' (Theorems 1.1, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, and 7.1). Without claiming to formalize Zariski-closed Euclidean spectral price sublevels, Gaussian mean-width tail bounds, or the excluded-grid minor theorem end-to-end, we construct a four-mode exact verifier over Z, Q, and F_p paired with 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings). Across 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16), we certify (i) Eq. (1.1) graph state sums Z_{G,q}(X), Section 2 subgraph projections, exact cut flattening ranks q^{|dC|}, opposite-axis terminal norms ||a_C||^2=|dC|, and Lemma 3.2 movable supply-site savings, (ii) Theorem 4.1 balanced-cut grid isoperimetry (exhaustively over all 336 balanced cuts of G_3 and witnesses on G_4) plus Section 4 characteristic-free VNP_F Boolean-indicator sums over F_7 and F_2, (iii) Eq. (5.1) binary-tree telescoping identities, exact Bharadwaj-Chandran boundary profiles on T_3 and T_5 (k*=11, min|dU|=3), and Lemma 5.2 ABP prefix-rank decompositions, and (iv) Lemma 6.3 dyadic scale clustering on P_4, P_8, Section 6.3 strictly upper-triangular cofactor determinant embeddings, and Lemma 7.2 weighted-centroid minor projections (C_5 >= K_3 and degree-4 tuple-packed T_6 >= K_{1,4}, pw=1 <= cw=2 <= 6). All 16 certificates, 69 unit/forgery tests, and 37 SHA-256 hashes verify deterministically.
